source.rule: RBDParallelStructure.QTYPB is the number of subblocks of that type; RBDParallel.NBREQ counts required working output links and NBOP counts active links. MaterielStructure.QTYPM gives installed copies.

configuration.base: G04 active 2-of-3 parent: POS-A, POS-B and nonfailing POS-C; each physical and RBD quantity one, NBOP3, NBREQ2
configuration.child: Two installed POS-C copies and RBD QTYPB2; NBOP4 and NBREQ2, all active
configuration.failure_modes: POS-A 300000 and POS-B 600000 per million operating hours, POS-C without configured failure mode
configuration.mission: one 26-hour mission scheduled h8 to h34
configuration.maintenance: unchanged half-hour direct CM after mission return; no stock demand expected

exact_delta: Change only ProblemDescription, MaterielStructure POS-C QTYPM 1→2, RBDParallel NBOP 3→4 plus description, and RBDParallelStructure POS-C QTYPB 1→2. NBREQ, A/B failure rates, mission, repairs, seed, report controls and all other tables stay fixed.
pre_run_hypotheses: Native import/export preserves the four-table delta and converter accepts the physical/RBD multiplicity alignment with zero errors and only reviewed diagnostics.

If both configured A/B failures recur before repair, two zero-failure POS-C links should leave the active 2-of-4 RBD functional and the long mission should complete at h34, versus the accepted 2-of-3 parent abort after the second failure. Record actual identity and times; identical draws are a hypothesis, not assumed evidence.
The report should reconcile the native event path and the physical readiness/repair interval. One fixed seed cannot establish a population reliability effect.
native_acceptance: Unique guarded session-0 SSH run, host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 checks, registry restoration and frozen source/raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table native roundtrip, zero converter errors/notes, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Event-level A/B failures, any POS-C identities, criticality and mission outcome reconcile with parent events and 72-bin System/Stock report; no inference from aggregate metrics alone.
Separate read-only reviewer replays source, raw seals, events and report independently of author validation.
diagnostic_gate: If converter rejects the model, native multiplicity differs from authored values, A/B event samples diverge, or the expected 2-of-4 path is not observed, preserve the run as diagnostic and revise under a new candidate version/run ID rather than claiming paired proof.
limits: One POS-C duplication, one seed and one replication; no arbitrary multiplicity, all-failed states or population effect.
No passive branch, nonzero switch time, online maintenance, GUI RBD visual or cross-engine claim.
